newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Sterling seen pushing above 2.81 marks.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Sterling seen pushing above 2.81 marks.

text.p: Sterling is poised to reclaim its foothold above 2.81 marks and $1.64 in Europe, and remain cushioned around 181 yen after a skid to fresh six-month lows of 181.59 in early dealings, said chartists.
"If it (sterling) breaks above 2.82 marks it could attempt to tackle 2.83 marks and then the highs around 2.8331," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank.

At 0735 GMT, sterling/mark stood at 2.8085/95 against 2.8168/73 in late Europe on Tuesday. Cable was at $1.6412/22 against $1.6374/84 in late Europe and sterling/yen at 182.23/2.44 vs around 184 yen in late Europe.
